fact: The ITAP report of 9 November 2023 states that Madagascar's education ministry has an EMIS and regular statistical yearbooks, and that EMIS production has had no dedicated budget line in the ministry's budget and has depended on external partners to fund data collection over the last decade.
title: Report of the Independent Technical Advisory Panel (ITAP): Assessment of Enabling Factors, Madagascar
publisher: Global Partnership for Education, Independent Technical Advisory Panel
